title.en: AN ACT MAKING PERMANENT, THE TEMPORARY AUTHORITY TO APPOINT A PROPERTY CLERK IN THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION CONTAINED IN AN ACT PASSED SEPTEMBER TWELFTH, NINETEEN HUNDRED.
title.orig: AN ACT MAKING PERMANENT, THE TEMPORARY AUTHORITY TO APPOINT A PROPERTY CLERK IN THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION CONTAINED IN AN ACT PASSED SEPTEMBER TWELFTH, NINETEEN HUNDRED.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The authority conferred by an Act of the United States Philippine Commission, passed September
twelfth, nineteen hundred, to appoint temporarily a property clerk in the Department of Education is hereby
made permanent.
The authority herein conferred shall relate to October eighth, last.

If the person appointed under and by authority of the Act of September twelfth, nineteen hundred,
shall be reappointed under the present Act, he shall have the benefit of the provisions of section twenty-two
of the Civil Service Act.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 24, 1900.
